text.en:
1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Federal Roads
Ordinance, 1959, and shall be deemed to have come into
force on Merdeka Day.

2. In this Ordinance—
"Minister" means the Minister charged with responsibi-
lity for transport.

3. The Minister may after consultation with the Govern-
ment of the State concerned, by order declare any road,
bridge, ferry or other means of communication in any
State to be Federal.

4. Any order under section 3 shall be published in the
Gazette and, as soon as possible thereafter, shall be laid
before the House of Representatives; and if, at the next
meeting of the House of Representatives after any such
order is laid before it a resolution is passed annulling such
order or any part thereof, such order or such part thereof
shall, but without prejudice] to the validity of anything
previously done thereunder, |be void as from the date of
notification in the Gazette of the passing of such resolution.

5. The roads, bridges and ferries specified or referred to
in the declaration made by the High Commissioner on the
fourteenth day of August, 1957, in pursuance of Item 91
of the Second Schedule of, the Federation of Malaya
Agreement, 1948, and published as Legal Notification 339
of 1957, are hereby declared to be federal, and such
declaration shall, for the purpose of amendment, variation
or revocation thereof, be deemed to be an order duly made
under sections 3 and 4.

KUALA LUMPUR
PRINTED BY THE ACTING GOVERNMENT PRINTER AND PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY ON 28TH JULY, 1959
